_comment: Mission 1, Scene 4: the back door and going home (docs/script/mission1.md). Branches on envelope_opened only (Carr opening it in secondary, envelope_inspected, doesn't count). Loyalty +1 / -1 once, on the first beat of the branch. Then going home: unopened only, the phone buzzes and the text from Unknown number. Events: door_opens (the open door frame and Walt), door_closes (the closed frame again).

knock.text: Mateo knocks. Nothing. He knocks again.

opens.text: The door opens a few inches. A man in his fifties, sleeves rolled up, a wrench in one hand.

envelope.text: Mateo takes out the envelope. Walt takes it and turns it over. He looks at the signature on the flap.

phone.text: He takes out his phone, types one word, and sends it.

thicker_unopened.text: He hands Mateo a different envelope. It's thicker.

torn.text: He looks at the torn signature. Then at Mateo.

no_phone.text: He doesn't take out his phone.

thicker_opened.text: He hands Mateo a different envelope. It's thicker.

cash.text: Mateo looks inside. Cash. He counts it twice.
